record.bible_text: Now in the twenty<WH06242> and fourth<WH0702> day<WH03117> of this month<WH02320> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> were assembled<WH0622><WTH8738> with fasting<WH06685>, and with sackclothes<WH08242>, and earth<WH0127> upon them.
